name: p2p-talk-native
description: P2P Talk phone apps: the P2P Talk web app inside Capacitor for Android and iPhone

scripts.ios:build-sim: npm run sync && xcodebuild -project ios/App/App.xcodeproj -scheme App -configuration Debug -sdk iphonesimulator -derivedDataPath ios/build CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
scripts.android:apk: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.mac:build: npm run sync-web && xcodebuild -project macos/P2PTalk.xcodeproj -scheme P2PTalk -configuration Release -derivedDataPath macos/build/dd -allowProvisioningUpdates build
scripts.mac:archive: npm run sync-web && xcodebuild archive -project macos/P2PTalk.xcodeproj -scheme P2PTalk -configuration Release -destination generic/platform=macOS -archivePath release/mac/P2P-Talk-mac.xcarchive -derivedDataPath macos/build/dd -allowProvisioningUpdates
